import unittest
from fsm.coordinator import ProtocolFSM, InvalidTransitionError

class TestFSM(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transitions(self):
        f = ProtocolFSM()
        f.transition("PREPARE")
        f.transition("COMMIT")
        f.transition("DONE")
        self.assertEqual(f.history, ["INIT", "PREPARE", "COMMIT", "DONE"])
        with self.assertRaises(InvalidTransitionError):
            f.transition("INIT")

if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main()
